Download

Build 098 is distributed as a complete Meta Quest Android ASTC archive.

DOWNLOAD BUILD 098VIEW GITHUB RELEASE

Install

  1. Download the complete Build 098 archive and extract it fully.
  2. Connect the Meta Quest headset to a Windows PC over USB.
  3. Enable Developer Mode and USB debugging, then accept the debugging request inside the headset.
  4. Run Install_Project_2088_SD-arm64.bat.
  5. Keep the installer open and launch Project 2088 from Unknown Sources inside the headset.
  6. Allow the remaining files to install, then wait for the PC installer to finish before disconnecting.
  7. Launch Project 2088 again from Unknown Sources.
